title: Digest sync records success even when downloads fail
reasoning: Both combined and legacy digest sync paths can encounter per-digest download failures, but still return WorkManager success and advance the last digest sync timestamp. If sync planning uses that timestamp as a watermark, failed digests can be skipped permanently; even without that, WorkManager is told no retry is needed after a partial sync failure.
recommendation: Track failed digest downloads/saves and return retry or failure when any required digest fails. Only advance the last sync time after all required digests have been persisted, or persist a per-digest cursor that cannot skip failed items.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests only cover scheduler delay helpers and a local EPUB test helper; there is no DigestSyncWorker test for partial download failures or watermark advancement.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a DigestSyncWorker test where planSync returns two digests, one download succeeds and one returns GhostwriterResult.Error, then assert Result.retry() is returned and setLastDigestSyncTime is not called.
minimumFixScope: DigestSyncWorker combined and legacy result handling around per-digest failures and last-sync timestamp updates.
